Container.Name: Freeman Notes
Container.Overview: Freeman Notes is a self-hosted, offline-first, real-time collaborative note-taking PWA. Features include rich text notes, checklists with counts, drawings (Excalidraw), @mentions, inbox activity feed, push notifications, themes, and full offline support via IndexedDB + Yjs CRDT sync.[br][br]Requires a PostgreSQL 16 database. Redis 7 is strongly recommended for real-time multi-tab sync.
Container.DonateText: If Freeman Notes is useful to you, a coffee is always appreciated!

Config.Name: Uploads / Media Storage
Config.Description: Where uploaded images and documents are stored. Must persist across container restarts.

Config.Name: OCR Model Cache
Config.Description: Caches the PaddleOCR model (~300 MB). Strongly recommended to avoid re-downloading on every container recreate. Leave empty to use a Docker anonymous volume.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: The port Freeman Notes is served on. Change the left value to use a different host port (e.g. 8080:27015).

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: Your public-facing URL. Required for invitation links, PWA deep links, and push notification payloads. Example: https://notes.yourdomain.com (no trailing slash).

Config.Name: Upload Directory (container path)
Config.Description: Container-side path for uploaded media. Must match the Target of the Uploads volume mount above.

Config.Name: Image Max Dimension (px)
Config.Description: Max long-edge pixel size for uploaded/captured images. Higher = sharper images, more storage. ~0.5MB/photo at the default 2560px/0.82 quality — budget that x images-per-user x user-count. Only affects new uploads.

Config.Name: Image JPEG Quality
Config.Description: JPEG quality (0.1-1.0) for uploaded/captured images. Higher = sharper but larger files. Paired with Image Max Dimension above for the storage estimate.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL 16 connection string. Create the database and user first. Replace HOST with your Postgres container name or IP. Format: postgresql://USER:PASS@HOST:PORT/DBNAME?schema=public

Config.Name: DB Schema Sync Mode
Config.Description: How to apply database schema changes on startup. 'deploy' (default) applies committed migrations safely. 'push' syncs directly (dev only — can drop data). 'none' skips migrations.

Config.Name: DB Baseline on Non-Empty (recovery)
Config.Description: Set to 'true' only as a one-time recovery fix for Prisma error P3005 (migration baseline on an existing schema). Leave empty in normal operation.

Config.Name: Postgres Timezone
Config.Description: Optional PostgreSQL timezone string (e.g. America/New_York). Leave empty to use the database server's default timezone.

Config.Name: Redis URL
Config.Description: Redis 7 connection string. Optional but recommended — enables real-time reminder badge sync across tabs, Yjs doc caching, and multi-instance pub/sub. Leave empty to run without Redis (all core features still work). Format: redis://HOST:PORT or redis://:PASSWORD@HOST:PORT

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Secret used to sign session cookies. MUST be changed from the default before exposing to the internet. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Allow Registration
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to allow anyone with the URL to create an account. Set to 'false' to disable self-registration (admins can still invite users via invite tokens).

Config.Name: Cookie Secure (HTTPS)
Config.Description: Controls the Secure flag on the session cookie. 'true' = force Secure (HTTPS only). 'false' = force off. Leave empty for auto-detection from request headers (recommended behind a reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Session Expiry (days)
Config.Description: Rolling session lifetime in days. Each authenticated request refreshes the expiry. Leave empty for non-expiring sessions.

Config.Name: bcrypt Rounds
Config.Description: bcrypt password hashing cost factor. Higher values are more secure but increase login time. Recommended: 12 (default). Range: 10–14 for typical hardware.

Config.Name: Cookie Name
Config.Description: Name of the HTTP-only session cookie. Only change this if running multiple Freeman Notes instances on the same domain.

Config.Name: SMTP Host
Config.Description: SMTP server hostname for outbound email (password resets, invite notifications). Leave empty to disable email. Example: smtp.gmail.com

Config.Name: SMTP Port
Config.Description: SMTP server port. 587 = STARTTLS (recommended), 465 = SSL/TLS, 25 = plain (not recommended).

Config.Name: SMTP Secure (SSL)
Config.Description: 'true' for implicit SSL (port 465). 'false' for STARTTLS (port 587, recommended).

Config.Name: SMTP Username
Config.Description: SMTP authentication username (usually your email address). Leave empty if the server does not require authentication.

Config.Name: SMTP Password
Config.Description: SMTP authentication password or app-specific password. Stored as a container secret.

Config.Name: SMTP From Address
Config.Description: The 'From' address on outbound emails. Example: Freeman Notes <no-reply@yourdomain.com>

Config.Name: VAPID Public Key
Config.Description: VAPID public key for Web Push (browser and Android PWA notifications). Generate with: npx web-push generate-vapid-keys. Leave empty to disable Web Push.

Config.Name: VAPID Private Key
Config.Description: VAPID private key — keep secret. Paired with VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY above.

Config.Name: VAPID Subject
Config.Description: Contact URI for the VAPID subject claim. Required when VAPID keys are set. Use your email: mailto:you@example.com or your site URL: https://yourdomain.com

Config.Name: FCM Project ID
Config.Description: Firebase project ID for iOS push notifications via FCM. Found in Firebase Console → Project Settings. Leave empty if not supporting iOS push.

Config.Name: FCM Client Email
Config.Description: Service account email from the Firebase Admin SDK JSON file. Used for iOS FCM push.

Config.Name: FCM Private Key
Config.Description: Service account private key (PEM) from the Firebase Admin SDK JSON. Include the full -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- block. Keep secret.

Config.Name: Web Notification Mode
Config.Description: Delivery mode for browser/desktop push notifications. auto | push | email | off

Config.Name: Android Notification Mode
Config.Description: Delivery mode for Android PWA push notifications. auto | push | email | off

Config.Name: iOS Notification Mode
Config.Description: Delivery mode for iOS push notifications (requires FCM). auto | push | email | off

Config.Name: Disable OCR
Config.Description: Set to '1' to disable PaddleOCR text extraction from uploaded images. Images will still upload and display; only text search of image content is disabled. Reduces CPU usage on image uploads.

Config.Name: OCR Python Binary
Config.Description: Path to the Python executable used to run PaddleOCR. The default points to the virtual environment bundled in the container image. Only change if mounting a custom OCR environment.

Config.Name: OCR Log Output
Config.Description: Set to '1' to forward PaddleOCR stdout/stderr to the container log. Useful for debugging image extraction failures.

Config.Name: PaddleOCR Model Home
Config.Description: Directory where PaddleOCR downloads and caches its models (~300 MB). Should match the Target of the 'OCR Model Cache' volume mount above.

Config.Name: PaddleOCR Model Source
Config.Description: Where PaddleOCR downloads its model on first run. 'BOS' = Baidu Object Storage (default, fast in Asia). Leave as BOS unless you have network issues reaching it.

Config.Name: Trash Cleanup Interval (ms)
Config.Description: How often (in milliseconds) the server permanently deletes trashed notes past their retention period. Default: 3600000 (1 hour). Set to 0 to disable.

Config.Name: Workspace Cleanup Interval (ms)
Config.Description: How often (in milliseconds) the server purges orphaned workspace data. Default: 3600000 (1 hour).

Config.Name: Workspace Cleanup Grace Period (ms)
Config.Description: How long (in milliseconds) after workspace deletion before its data is permanently purged. Default: 86400000 (24 hours). Increase for a longer recovery window.

Config.Name: Debug Logging
Config.Description: Set to '1' to enable verbose server-side debug logging (Yjs sync events, auth flows, etc.). Leave '0' in production to avoid log noise.
